```artifact
Decision Table for Requirement RW-SW-63:
| Condition | Condition Description                              | Action | Action Description                              |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------|
| Pressure Fall Phase | System in pressure fall phase | Meet Commanded Pressure | Within overshoot of 0.8*PEEP-1 cmH2O |

Decision Table for Requirement RW-SW-64:
| Condition | Condition Description                              | Action | Action Description                              |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------|
| Commanded PEEP | System receives commanded PEEP value | Meet Commanded PEEP | Within ±1 cmH2O + 10% of commanded PEEP |

Decision Table for Requirement RW-SW-95:
| Condition | Condition Description                              | Action | Action Description                              |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------|
| Target FiO2 Command | System receives target FiO2 command | Achieve Target FiO2 | Within 0.05 of commanded FiO2 |

Decision Table for Requirement RW-SW-97:
| Condition | Condition Description                              | Action | Action Description                              |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------|
| FiO2 Measurement | Prior to patient inhale limb | Report FiO2 | Report measured FiO2 value |

Decision Table for Requirement RW-SW-98:
| Condition | Condition Description                              | Action | Action Description                              |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------|
| Air Conditions | Temperature, altitude, humidity vary | Achieve Commanded Values | Maintain commanded values under varying air density conditions |

Decision Table for Requirement RW-SW-153:
| Condition | Condition Description                              | Action | Action Description                              |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------|
| Assist/Control Mode | Pressure controlled ventilation mode | Trigger Inspiration | Detect patient inspiration for assisted inspiration |

Decision Table for Requirement RW-SW-156:
| Condition | Condition Description                              | Action | Action Description                              |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------|
| Absurd Command | Data corruption or invalid command received | Safety Measure | Ignore or nullify absurd command to prevent unsafe operation |
```
